text:
rob: Heads-up - OmniRetail ready to sign for a 6mo reserved commit. They want a validated capacity plan: baseline 1.2k req/min, spikes to 8k req/min for ~10m. p95 < 300ms. Need reserved GPUs + burst credits and preheat notes.

hana: Quick conversion: 8k req/min = ~133 req/s. Avg tokens ~14 => ~1860 tokens/sec peak.
diego: For our quantized-medium on A100-like nodes we assume ~600 tokens/sec per GPU conservative, with batching can get ~2x. Use 1000 tokens/sec effective. So peak -> ~2 GPUs base, but for SLO/redundancy recommend 4 reserved + 2 burst.
hana: Autoscale snippet (short):
```yaml
reserved: 4
burst_credits: 2
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 10
target_tokens_per_gpu: 1000
scale_up_cooldown_s: 60
scale_down_cooldown_s: 240
```
diego: Preheat plan: KV prefix warm for 10m + synthetic ramp 3m. Provisioning lag note: reserved attach ~8-12m, burst ~2-5m. Freeze scale-down during business-critical windows.

security: Need to confirm KMS CMK support and log export. We can do CMK + S3 export; 365d retention available as paid add-on.
sales-ops: I'll add 6mo quote: 4 GPUs reserved, 2 burst credits/mo, ~18% discount vs on-demand. Adding KMS/HSM or extended logs is extra.

infra-bot: infra-bot: preheat job queued omni-preheat-2415000060 by diego (status: queued)

rob: Thanks team - I'll send runbook + quote to OmniRetail and ask for historical hourly samples to refine. Ping here if they want a tighter p95 target. :thumbsup:
